content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial permits a formal appeal, while retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable under this payer's rules. Correcting the invalid diagnosis pairing alone would not resolve the missing authorization, and billing the full balance would exceed the patient's contractual share. Although an appeal was previously attempted, no published rule bars another appeal, and similar claims favor appeal_with_necessity (1/3 paid) over patient billing or write-off.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
